question: Every year the Flamingo festival is celebrated at the Pulicat Lake near the Nellapattu Bird Sanctuary located in _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Andhra Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Flamingo Festival is a significant event celebrated in India, particularly in the **state of Andhra Pradesh**.
 
• The Flamingo Festival is primarily celebrated at **Pulicat Lake**, which is located near the border of Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu.
 
• The festival is primarily focused on the **Greater Flamingo (Phoenicopterus roseus) and the Lesser Flamingo (Phoenicopterus minor)**.
 
• The festival is typically held in **January each yea**r, coinciding with the migratory season when flamingos.
